recipe.variant: 7B Int8 (8.33 GB): the official 7B image template file; docs: 'higher quality'; scale 2; whole clip sampled as one latent (template default); use the -chunked variant on OOM or long clips
recipe.from_template: utility_seedvr2_3b_int8_upscale_video (subgraph 'Upscale Video (SeedVR2 3B Int8)' flattened; the trim_video switch resolved OFF so 'Video Slice' is elided - trim upstream; the split_latent switch resolved OFF: the whole clip is one latent, the template default). unet_name swapped to seedvr2_7b_int8_convrot.safetensors from the official Comfy-Org/SeedVR2 repack (docs.comfy.org file table); no official 7B video template exists. Template resize node is ResizeImageMaskNode ('scale by multiplier', lanczos). Written here as ImageScaleBy (lanczos, scale_by): the same lanczos resample of the IMAGE (RGBA passes through), because the offline validator cannot type ResizeImageMaskNode's COMFY_MATCHTYPE_V3 socket. Swap back on the box if the v3 node is preferred.

scale.note: upscale factor; the DiT restores at the resolution it is handed (template default 4 for stills, 2 for video). VRAM and time scale with output megapixels x frames

seed.note: one-step models still consume noise: the seed changes micro-detail

denoise.note: 1.0 = full restore (template); lower values are exposed by the template but undocumented

sampler_name.note: euler (template); no official guidance beyond the default

color_correction_method.note: none (template) | lab (node default, 'most faithful', most memory) | wavelet | adain

unet_name.note: swap precision/size here: see profile.files (same graph for every seedvr2_* file)

temporal_size.note: frames the VAE encodes/decodes at a time (template 64 for video, 4096 for stills)

video.note: the clip to restore/upscale; frames, audio, fps and bit_depth are read by GetVideoComponents and audio/fps/bit_depth pass through to CreateVideo unchanged. The frame count is padded to 4n+1 by SeedVR2Preprocess and cropped back by SeedVR2PostProcessing.

recipe.defaults_note: scale 2 (template default for video); 1 step / cfg 1 / euler / simple / denoise 1; VAE tiling 512/128, temporal 64/8; color correction none; source fps, audio and bit depth preserved (linked from GetVideoComponents, never literals). Template tip for long inputs: trim and process segments, or switch to the -chunked variant.

vram_evidence.usage: NOT FOUND: the official chunk-size law was fitted on the 3B fp16 only; docs say INT8 is 'reduced VRAM usage compared to FP16' and 7B is 'higher quality'. Community tiers (numz README): 12-16 GB for fp8-class files, 24 GB+ for fp16
